notes.title: Achievements Added to Valiant Hearts: Coming Home
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
 
We are pleased to announce that Steam Achievements are now available for Valiant Hearts: Coming Home!

As a heads up, achievements will be retroactively earned for the accomplishments already completed in your game. For the sync to happen you need to launch the game once, and the previously unlocked Ubisoft Connect achievements will be automatically unlocked on Steam.

notes.title: На Западном фронте все хуже и хуже: Обзор Valiant Hearts: Coming Home
notes.notes: "Ненужный сиквел" — проклятие, рано или поздно нависающее над любой оригинальной задумкой, будь то пеплум-блокбастер с трагичным финалом, драма про полуголый труп в набедренной повязке или штучная история про пиктку с голосами в голове. Дополнит ли продолжение изначальную задумку, имевшую интригующее начало и конкретный финал, или будет паразитировать на ней? Ответ зачастую очевиден.

notes.title: Valiant Hearts: Coming Home out now on Steam!
notes.notes:
As World War 1 still rages on, (re)discover the heartfelt stories of our Valiant Hearts James, Anna, Georges and Ernst, and of course the faithful dog Walt. Emerge from the sea into the middle of the Jutland naval battle, relive the Argonne offensive and experience the long-awaited relief of the Armistice. Solve puzzles, sneak through enemy lines, fly above the chaos, heal the wounded, and even play some music.

notes.title: The sequel to the best World War I game ever finally arrives on Steam
notes.notes:
When I think of the best war games ever made, I'm struck less by the bombast of Battlefield, Call of Duty, or War Thunder, and more by those games that evoke the powerful emotions of human conflict. This War of Mine will always stay with me. 2023's Amnesia: The Bunker is a fantastic modern example. And then there's Valiant Hearts: The Great War. The masterful Ubisoft Montpellier creation focuses on four small, interweaving stories and truly drives home the brutal realities of WWI in an unforgettable and often devastating way. Now, more than a year after its initial release, you can finally get the sequel on Steam.
